args.title: Corvid Packaging newsletter — Retail returns logistics
args.body:
• Newsletter: Corvid Packaging's latest newsletter covers retail returns logistics and links to a feature article at blog.corvid.example/2026/returns, with a companion case study for active-project readers.
• Article: Apparel return rates have reached 24%; consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by a fifth (~20%).
• Companion piece (BLUE HERON access): Reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the margin.
